summary: Comprehensive backend testing of LSIM Quick SMS integration (Iteration 44). 25/25 pytest tests passed covering: balance, templates CRUD, single SMS send, bulk (companies/contacts/explicit), logs + filters, stats, dispatch-daily with idempotency, admin-only permission (403 for sales role), and phone normalization. All send/bulk/dispatch tests used deliberately invalid numbers (00000000/11111111/994000000000/994500000000) to avoid real SMS costs — final balance dropped only 5 credits (9289→9284).

minor.issue: Not admin-gated (GET returns default/overridden templates to any authenticated user). PUT is correctly admin-only. Consider whether templates should be visible to non-admin roles.

Uses `created_at >= today_iso` string comparison (today_iso='YYYY-MM-DD' vs ISO timestamps). Works lexicographically today, but will incorrectly include UTC-midnight-boundary items that straddle timezones if server tz changes. Consider datetime range.

Idempotency key for event_reminder is per-phone (f"{event_id}:{comp_id}:{phone}"). If owner_phone value is later edited to a different number on the same day, a duplicate reminder will be sent. Not a functional bug, edge case only.

action_items: Optional: Consider admin-gating GET /api/sms/templates (currently any authenticated user can read templates).
Optional: Replace string-comparison today filter in /sms/logs/stats with a datetime $gte filter for robustness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is very large (6115 lines) — SMS endpoints alone span ~300 lines (4795–5130). Consider extracting to /app/backend/routers/sms_router.py for maintainability.
sms_service.py log_sms pops '_id' AFTER insert_one mutation — correct pattern, good.
_collect_company_phones correctly dedupes per-company, and /sms/bulk dedupes again by normalized msisdn across recipients — double protection, good.
dispatch-daily sequentially awaits every LSIM call in a loop; for events with 500+ invitations this will be slow. Consider asyncio.gather with a semaphore for concurrency throttling.
Phone normalization correctly handles '+994 50 123 45 67', '0501234567', '501234567' → '994501234567'. Verified via parametrized tests.
Template placeholders are stripped if unresolved — good UX protection (users never see raw {placeholder}).
test_credentials: Admin: settings@marsol.az / marsol123; Sales: satis@marsol.az / marsol123 — both verified working.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_SMS_ prefixed companies, events, and invitations; all cleaned up in module-scope fixture teardown. ~12 sms_logs records created (5 manual, 4 bulk, 3 event_reminder) — left in db for inspection; safe to purge via `db.sms_logs.delete_many({'text': {'$regex': '^TEST_SMS_'}})`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMS backend fully validated. LSIM balance at end of run was 9284 (used 5 credits). All invalid-phone sends correctly logged as status='failed' with error_code=-102 (Yanlış nömrə formatı). Idempotency of dispatch-daily confirmed via double invocation — second call produced skipped>=1 and no duplicate logs for the same (event_id, company_id, phone) key within the same calendar day. Phone normalization works for all common AZ formats. Frontend (Settings → SMS tab) was NOT tested per request scope.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Implementation matches spec: sender=MARSOL, md5(md5(pwd)+login+msg+msisdn+sender) hash, unicode autodetect for Azerbaijani diacritics, sms_logs with category ∈ {manual,bulk,event_reminder,birthday}, admin-only permission on all mutating endpoints.
